content.comment_body: Hello, I'm using [product_name] [version_no]. However, when attempting to use the original software from a USB stick, the "Update Center" option always appears greyed out. How can I make the Update Center selectable? Best regards, [user_name]

The Update Center in [product_name] hasn't worked since [version_no]. You can still download the update to [product_name] [version_no] for free from this location: [url]. Keep in mind that this download is subject to export restrictions and requires additional registration. You'll need to log in and provide certain information; for the company section, simply enter "Private use."

analysis.insight_summary: The user is unable to activate the 'Update Center' feature in [product_name] [version_no] because it remains disabled. The software's internal update function has been inoperable since a previous version, but this isn't transparently explained in the interface, resulting in user confusion about how to obtain updates.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to update [product_name] directly within the application through the 'Update Center' feature.
